definition: used to emphasize the most important quality, purpose or reason
translation: trước hết và quan trọng nhất
exampleSentence: First and foremost, this job is about helping people.
exampleTranslation: Trước hết và quan trọng nhất, công việc này là để giúp đỡ mọi người.

definition: scattered around or happening in several different places
exampleSentence: There were small shops here and there along the road.
exampleTranslation: Dọc con đường có những cửa hàng nhỏ rải rác đây đó.

definition: going in one direction and then in the opposite direction, again and again
exampleSentence: The ferry goes back and forth across the river.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc phà đi qua đi lại trên sông.

definition: backwards and forwards, or moving to a higher and then a lower position again and again
exampleSentence: The children were jumping up and down with excitement.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ nhảy lên nhảy xuống vì phấn khích.

definition: the mixture of good and bad experiences in any situation or relationship
translation: thăng trầm, lúc lên lúc xuống
exampleSentence: Every marriage has its ups and downs.
exampleTranslation: Hôn nhân nào cũng có lúc thăng lúc trầm.

definition: the willingness of two people to understand each other and let each other have some of what they want
exampleSentence: A good friendship needs some give and take.
exampleTranslation: Tình bạn tốt cần có sự nhường nhịn lẫn nhau.

definition: a way of learning in which you test many different methods to find the best one
exampleSentence: I learned to cook by trial and error.
exampleTranslation: Tôi học nấu ăn bằng cách thử và sai.

definition: the advantages and disadvantages of something
translation: ưu và nhược điểm, mặt lợi và mặt hại
exampleSentence: Let's look at the pros and cons before we decide.
exampleTranslation: Hãy xem xét ưu và nhược điểm trước khi quyết định.

definition: small things of various kinds that are not worth much
exampleSentence: The drawer is full of odds and ends.
exampleTranslation: Ngăn kéo đầy đồ lặt vặt.

definition: unharmed, especially after being in danger
exampleSentence: The missing children were found safe and sound.
exampleTranslation: Những đứa trẻ mất tích được tìm thấy bình an vô sự.

definition: showing pictures only in black, white and grey; also used about ideas that are too simple, as if everything is either good or bad
translation: trắng đen (ảnh, phim); rạch ròi một chiều
exampleSentence: My grandfather has an old black and white photo of the farm.
exampleTranslation: Ông tôi có một tấm ảnh trắng đen cũ chụp trang trại.

definition: angry or bored with something that has been happening for a long time
exampleSentence: I'm sick and tired of waiting for him.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chán ngấy việc chờ anh ta rồi.

definition: used to say that someone should be patient because they will find out something later
translation: cứ chờ xem, đợi xem sao
exampleSentence: We don't know the result yet. We'll just have to wait and see.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta chưa biết kết quả. Cứ phải chờ xem thôi.

definition: used about a situation in which there is a serious risk that something bad could happen
translation: ngàn cân treo sợi tóc, rất mong manh
exampleSentence: It was touch and go whether the patient would survive.
exampleTranslation: Bệnh nhân có qua khỏi hay không thật sự rất mong manh.

definition: a situation in which people respect the law and crime is controlled by the police
exampleSentence: The new mayor promised to restore law and order.
exampleTranslation: Thị trưởng mới hứa sẽ lập lại an ninh trật tự.

definition: very often; used to show that something keeps happening
translation: hết lần này đến lần khác
exampleSentence: I've told him time and again to lock the door.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã nhắc anh ấy hết lần này đến lần khác phải khóa cửa.

definition: whatever happens or whatever the weather is like
translation: dù mưa hay nắng, bất kể thế nào
exampleSentence: He walks to work every day, rain or shine.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào anh ấy cũng đi bộ đi làm, dù mưa hay nắng.

definition: to succeed or fail without help from anyone else
translation: tự bơi hay chìm, thành bại tự lo
exampleSentence: On her first day at work, they just said, "Sink or swim."
exampleTranslation: Ngày đầu đi làm, họ chỉ nói: "Tự lo liệu nhé."

definition: used to emphasize that something unpleasant is true or will happen and cannot be changed
exampleSentence: Like it or not, we have to pay the tax.
exampleTranslation: Dù muốn hay không, chúng ta cũng phải đóng thuế.

definition: in a way that is not planned or intended
exampleSentence: I deleted the file by accident.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vô tình xóa mất tập tin.

definition: without being planned or caused by people
exampleSentence: We met by chance at the airport.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tình cờ gặp nhau ở sân bay.

definition: without intending to do it
exampleSentence: I took your umbrella by mistake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cầm nhầm ô của bạn.

definition: if you know something by heart, you remember all of it exactly
exampleSentence: She knows the whole poem by heart.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thuộc lòng cả bài thơ.

definition: used to say that something is much better, worse, bigger and so on than anything else
exampleSentence: This is by far the best restaurant in town.
exampleTranslation: Đây là nhà hàng ngon nhất thành phố, hơn hẳn những nơi khác.

definition: used to mean "of course" when you politely allow someone to do something or agree with a suggestion
translation: tất nhiên rồi, cứ tự nhiên
exampleSentence: "May I sit here?" "By all means."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi ngồi đây được không?" "Tất nhiên rồi, cứ tự nhiên."

definition: not at all
translation: hoàn toàn không, không đời nào
exampleSentence: The exam was by no means easy.
exampleTranslation: Bài thi hoàn toàn không dễ.

definition: used to ask politely whether something is true
translation: không biết có tình cờ... không
exampleSentence: Do you know where the station is, by any chance?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có biết nhà ga ở đâu không?

definition: used to talk about the point when something happens or should happen
exampleSentence: By the time we got there, the film had started.
exampleTranslation: Đến lúc chúng tôi tới nơi, bộ phim đã bắt đầu.

definition: doing something quickly because you do not have much time
exampleSentence: I can't stop. I'm in a hurry.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không dừng lại được. Tôi đang vội.

definition: happening a number of times, one after the other
exampleSentence: She won three games in a row.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thắng ba ván liên tiếp.

definition: if things or people have something in common, they share the same features
exampleSentence: We have a lot in common.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi có rất nhiều điểm chung.

definition: if you do something in person, you go and do it yourself instead of using a letter or phone
exampleSentence: You need to collect the ticket in person.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần đích thân đến nhận vé.

definition: if you do something in public, you do it where anyone can see
translation: nơi công cộng, trước mặt mọi người
exampleSentence: She doesn't like speaking in public.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy không thích nói chuyện trước đám đông.

definition: without other people being present
exampleSentence: Can we talk in private?
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta nói chuyện riêng được không?

definition: without success in spite of your efforts
exampleSentence: He tried in vain to start the car.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy cố khởi động xe nhưng vô ích.

definition: having control of or responsibility for a group of people or an activity
exampleSentence: Who is in charge of the project?
exampleTranslation: Ai phụ trách dự án này?

definition: deliberately
exampleSentence: I didn't break it on purpose.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không cố ý làm vỡ nó.

definition: if you go somewhere on foot, you walk there
exampleSentence: We went to the market on foot.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi bộ ra chợ.

definition: based on a calculation of what usually happens or what the usual amount is
exampleSentence: On average, I read two books a month.
exampleTranslation: Trung bình mỗi tháng tôi đọc hai cuốn sách.

definition: if you do something on the spot, you do it immediately, often without thinking carefully
translation: ngay tại chỗ, ngay lập tức
exampleSentence: They offered her the job on the spot.
exampleTranslation: Họ đề nghị nhận cô ấy vào làm ngay tại chỗ.

definition: very busy doing a lot of things; informal
exampleSentence: I've been on the go since six this morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bận rộn suốt từ sáu giờ sáng nay.

definition: used to say that you have changed your mind about something; British English says "on second thoughts"
translation: nghĩ lại thì, suy nghĩ lại thì
exampleSentence: I'll have tea. On second thought, make it coffee.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi trà. Nghĩ lại thì cho tôi cà phê.

definition: for short periods but not regularly over a long time
translation: lúc có lúc không, ngắt quãng
exampleSentence: It rained on and off all day.
exampleTranslation: Trời mưa lúc có lúc không cả ngày.

definition: feeling relaxed, especially in a situation where people might feel nervous
exampleSentence: She felt at ease with her new classmates.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy cảm thấy thoải mái với các bạn học mới.

definition: in a situation where you may be harmed
translation: có nguy cơ, đứng trước nguy hiểm
exampleSentence: Children are most at risk from this disease.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ em có nguy cơ cao nhất mắc căn bệnh này.

definition: without any definite plan, aim or pattern
exampleSentence: The winners were chosen at random.
exampleTranslation: Những người thắng cuộc được chọn ngẫu nhiên.

definition: confused and not sure what to do or say
exampleSentence: I was at a loss for words.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lúng túng không biết nói gì.

definition: if something you value is at stake, you will lose it if a plan or action fails
translation: đang bị đe dọa, có nguy cơ mất
exampleSentence: Our jobs are at stake if we lose this client.
exampleTranslation: Công việc của chúng ta sẽ bị đe dọa nếu mất khách hàng này.

definition: whatever happens, whatever it takes
exampleSentence: We must protect the children at all costs.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta phải bảo vệ bọn trẻ bằng mọi giá.

definition: sometimes
exampleSentence: At times, I feel very lonely.
exampleTranslation: Đôi khi tôi cảm thấy rất cô đơn.
